rationale: Tracxn fintech directory is a one-off lead-mining list for SI fintech vendors but sits behind registration/paywall.
Adriatic PSP newsroom gives competitor-side positioning relevant to SI payments; low volume but standalone and public.
Croatian community tech media; occasional regional fintech landscape pieces, thin SI relevance — revisit.
Regulator fintech-hub section of bsi.si (19 siblings) — covered by monitoring the central bank domain, but in-scope and high credibility.
NLB TPP/API portal is prime vendor-fingerprint evidence; url_verification failed so recheck liveness before approving.
Bankart multi-bank PSD2 hub maps which SI banks outsource open banking — the single richest vendor-landscape source in the batch.
Addiko's own open-API portal exposes a non-Bankart platform choice; public and durable.
Intesa group portal's SI tenant documents centralised vendor decisions and NextGenPSD2 profile; public API docs.
OTP SI PSD2 page reveals processor choice post-merger and re-points when the stack changes.
Sparkasse PSD2 page documents its Bankart tenant explicitly — dated vendor proof, public.
Gorenjska banka PSD2 page names Bankart tenant and Berlin Group profile; watch for ownership-driven stack shifts.
Single API product page naming 'SRC PSD2 API Collection' — decisive vendor evidence, but the monitored source is the Bankart hub itself.
UniCredit group developer portal carries dated release notes covering the SI ASPSP; public and continuous.
Third-party aggregator enumerating SI ASPSP developer portals — mine once for the portal list, verify against primaries.
Play Store listing exposes Asseco as mobile-banking vendor via package id; versioned release notes make it a recurring signal stream.
Bankart job ads name product lines and technologies months before announcements; public careers page.
Optius per-company pages let a single bank's IT hiring wave be tracked; ads disclose platform names.
Largest SI commercial job board; primary venue where core-banking/card/payment-hub platforms get named.
Official state vacancy register — least suppressible national job-ad corpus, explicitly public.
Careerjet aggregates the boards already monitored; useful sweep layer but redundancy and ToS unclear.
Secondary SI board carrying payment-domain roles describing product roadmaps; public and allowed.
Minor board offering redundancy for short-lived ads; low unique yield — revisit if coverage gaps appear.
LinkedIn company/job pages are high-value vendor signal but require login and scraping is ToS-restricted; human must clear access.
Flik product/support pages are a bankart.si section already covered by monitoring the Bankart domain; participant lists are useful deployment evidence.
Slo-Tech forum has strong early signal on bank stacks but low individual reliability and unclear reuse terms.
Consumer tech site narrates SI bank app releases in dated detail — easier to monitor than store listings.
NLB Group press archive is the corroboration/dating anchor for digital-channel launches; public RSS-style stream.
